mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines for 3+ months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 5.0% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative or flat in >50% of UNRATE < 5.0% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer confidence and housing market recovery, jointly predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The RSAFS-HOUST interaction fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening economic momentum, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines do not yield negative 20-day returns in >60% of late-cycle instances, or Rank IC > -0.05 in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >50% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% instances, or Rank IC > 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market growth that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increases do not yield positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential investment (RSAFS) exceeding its 12-month moving average by 5% signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >50% of RSAFS > 12-month MA + 5% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases do not yield positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year window.
